positions.title: Senior Director of SL5 Task Force
Research Lead
positions.description:
Since March 2024, I've founded and now research lead MIRI's new technical governance team. We research verification mechanisms, international coordination on AI, limitations of model evaluations and do some AI forecasting. Our team advises policymakers and produces technical reports. Our focus is on long-term solutions for the AI governance space, with a particular focus on concerns that arise as we near ASI (artificial super intelligence). My personal research focus is currently on AI security and strategic implications of automated AI R&D on technical governance. 

Note: We will be expanding the team as of Jan 2025, please reach out if you're a specialist in any of the above areas!

positions.title: Research Manager
positions.description:
I research manage our 18 person technical staff and take point on research strategy, introducing new processes and people management, recruiting and restructuring to help MIRI execute its strategic pivot in summer 2023, as well as developing and project managing some of our new project directions.

Since January 2024, a large part of our research focus has pivoted towards AI technical governance research. We focus on researching and designing technical aspects of regulation and policy that could lead to safer AI, giving special consideration to which methods can (continue to) function as we move closer toward smarter-than-human AI.
The team works on: 
- Limitations of current proposals such as Responsible Scaling Policies. 
- Inputs into regulations, requests for comment by policy bodies (ex. NIST/US AISI, EU, UN)
- Researching and designing alternative Safety Standards, or amendments to existing proposals
- Communicating with and consulting for policymakers and governance organizations

company.name: Institute for Security and Technology (IST)
company.tagline: Uniting technology and policy leaders to create actionable solutions to emerging security challenges
company.description: The Institute for Security and Technology (IST) is the 501(c)(3) critical action think tank that unites technology and policy leaders to create solutions to emerging security challenges. IST stands at the forefront of convening policymakers, technology experts, and industry leaders to identify and translate discourse into impact. We take collaborative action to advance national security and global stability through technology built on trust, guiding businesses and governments with hands-on expertise, in-depth analysis, and a global network. Since its foundation in 2020, IST has launched a vast array of impactful initiatives addressing challenges such as ransomware, the resilience of lifeline critical infrastructure, trust and safety, nuclear risk reduction, the role of artificial intelligence, and more.
